reciprocal.link: K271 — The is this up to me check
reciprocal.why: A Stoic practice that sorts concerns by what is up to the actor, related to the psychological construct of beliefs about control.
The kernel is the CBT-form drill of the same Stoic rehearsal, running worst-case imagery with severity and probability tests.
The kernel trains courage in its social form: a weekly scheduled act of speaking up against unfairness.
Both practices keep a not-knowing position open; the kernel adds Rilke's patience with the unresolved.
The kernel operationalises redemption sequences, the page's central narrative form, as a writing practice.
The kernel trains courage in its civic form: a monthly act of public participation taken from the smallest rung currently avoided.
The page pairs the belief that ability grows with the structured practice that grows it, citing both sides of the practice-variance debate.
